VRAM Monitor v1.0.0

A real-time GPU VRAM monitoring utility using DirectX (DXGI) and NVIDIA Management Library (NVML).

• Real-time VRAM usage tracking
• Per-process VRAM breakdown
• Dark & Light theme support
